target_customer: Consumers and restaurants buying seafood alternatives
problem: Existing plant-based seafood lacks convincing taste, texture and nutrition, so few consumers switch.
business_model: Consumer food brand, wholesale to restaurants and retail

founders.name: Marilena Schmich
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page and launch post, education not listed.

founders.name: Anton Pluschke
prior_employers: Venture-backed plant-based dairy company (founding team member and Head of R&D, unnamed)
education: PhD Food Science and Biotechnology, University of Queensland

exit.reason: Coverage attributes the closure to the difficult funding climate for food tech; the company's own statement was not seen.

competitors.name: Good Catch
competitors.what: Plant-based tuna, later frozen fish, shrimp, crab

competitors.name: Sophie's Kitchen
competitors.what: Canned plant-based tuna and frozen shrimp and fillets

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching shrimp and salmon texture and taste with plant protein and biotechnology was unsolved for most players; the launch post reports buy intent rising only after 10 weeks of iteration.

defensibility.rationale: No patents or data moat were found in sources; recipes were copyable by funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought or copied it; several alt seafood peers also closed in 2024 per trade press.

market_need_then: Launch post cites 42 percent of people restricting animal products and survey buy intent rising from 23 percent to 63 percent for shrimp and 85 percent for salmon over 10 weeks.

branding.name_origin: Company was formerly Numi Foods per CB Insights; no source explains either name.

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources; date unknown

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: The team raised a small pre-seed and seed in 2022 and showed rising customer buy intent in YC, but the alternative seafood category saw funding dry up. Trade press says Ordinary Seafood ceased operations in February 2024 amid the harsh fundraising climate, alongside other alt seafood startups. The specific internal cause is not public beyond that.
notes: Funding rests on Bouncewatch and Nordic9 databases (single outlets each); CB Insights reports $2.5M over 3 rounds so rounds are missing amounts. Nordic9 states $500k total, conflicting. Company website returned 503 so was not read.
